rule.unit: one sample = one distinct effectiveSeed. Paths that force odd seeds (career, challenge) walk odd seeds only (step 2): an odd seed is its own effectiveSeed, an even seed 2k would silently replay engine seed 2k+1
rule.disjoint: no two studies share an effectiveSeed, and no study touches a used or reserved range below
rule.layout: objectiveLayoutForSeed(effectiveSeed) decides STANDARD/SWAPPED; reported per study, walking studies stop when both layouts reach the target
